summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running any code and without committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coordinates) pairs with start/stop per dimension including channel; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes; docstrings updated), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; NumPy ceil replaces math; PatchDataset docstring uses float), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc after GridPatchDataset), and new tests/test_grid_dataset.py with TestGridPatchDataset (test_shape, test_loading_array). Not verified: tests have not been run, and the GridPatchDataset docstring output lines were derived by hand. Choices to review: the second test image is a reversed ramp rather than +16 so the two images are distinguishable; the multi-worker check matches patches to source regions after removing the per-patch shift. Pre-existing lines 228-230 in utils.py exceed 120 characters and were left alone.
